stories.title: Ethereum bug forces emergency fixes on major layer-2 networks
stories.summary: A software bug in Ethereum triggered emergency fixes across several major layer-2 networks, CryptoSlate reported. The report does not name the affected networks. It also does not explain the bug's root cause.
stories.whyItMatters: Layer-2 networks carry a large share of Ethereum activity. A shared bug raises questions about shared infrastructure risk.
whatToWatch: Post-mortems from the affected layer-2 teams
Whether the fix needs further network upgrades
questions: Which layer-2 networks were affected?
Did the bug cause any loss of funds?

sources.title: Ethereum software bug triggers emergency fixes across major layer-2 networks

stories.title: Bitcoin ETFs bought nearly 2x Q3 mined supply, then saw $430 million leave in a day
stories.summary: Bitcoin ETFs bought close to twice the Bitcoin that miners produced in the third quarter, CryptoSlate reported. Despite that pace, the ETFs saw about $430 million in net outflows on a single Thursday. The report frames this as a sharp swing within an otherwise strong quarter for inflows.
stories.whyItMatters: ETF demand has been a major driver of Bitcoin's price. A sudden outflow tests whether that demand holds.
whatToWatch: Whether the outflow trend continues or reverses
Next quarter's ETF buying pace versus mined supply
questions: What drove the Thursday outflow?
Which funds saw the largest redemptions?

sources.title: Bitcoin ETFs bought nearly twice what miners produced in Q3—but $430 million left on Thursday

stories.title: Greece sets 10% tax on Bitcoin profits, ending years of uncertainty
stories.summary: Greece introduced a 10% tax on Bitcoin profits, CryptoSlate reported. The move ends a long stretch of unclear tax rules for crypto holders in the country. The report does not state an effective date or detail how the rule applies to other cryptocurrencies.
stories.whyItMatters: Clear tax rules remove a barrier for crypto investors. The move could shape how other EU states tax digital assets.
whatToWatch: The effective date of the new tax
Whether other EU countries set similar rates
questions: Does the 10% rate apply to assets beyond Bitcoin?
How will Greece enforce reporting of crypto profits?

sources.title: Greece ends years of crypto tax uncertainty with new 10% levy on Bitcoin profits

stories.title: Bitcoin miner IREN pushes AI revenue milestone to 2027, seeks $6 billion for expansion
stories.summary: Bitcoin miner IREN delayed a key AI revenue milestone into 2027, CryptoSlate reported. The company is seeking $6 billion to fund its expansion. The report ties the delay to the scale of IREN's buildout plans.
stories.whyItMatters: IREN's shift toward AI computing shows a wider trend. Bitcoin miners are diversifying revenue beyond mining rewards.
whatToWatch: Progress on the $6 billion funding effort
Updates on the revised 2027 timeline
questions: What caused the delay from the original timeline?
How will IREN split capacity between mining and AI workloads?

sources.title: Bitcoin miner IREN’s AI revenue milestone slips into 2027 as expansion seeks $6 billion

stories.title: Ardoino's 24/7 asset trading plan hinges on patient buyers
stories.summary: Ardoino outlined a plan for round-the-clock asset trading, CryptoSlate reported. The plan's success depends on buyers willing to wait for their cash after a trade settles. The report gives few details on which assets or markets the plan covers.
stories.whyItMatters: A 24/7 trading model would change how settlement risk works for crypto-linked assets, and readers should watch who adopts it.
whatToWatch: Further detail on which assets the plan covers
Market reaction from buyers facing settlement delays
questions: How long would buyers need to wait for cash?
Which markets or assets would launch first?

sources.title: Ardoino’s 24/7 asset plan depends on buyers willing to wait for cash

stories.title: AI watchdog report claims superintelligence could arrive within six months
stories.summary: A report from an AI watchdog group suggests superintelligent AI could arrive in under six months, CryptoSlate reported. The report does not name the group or explain its methodology. Claims about near-term superintelligence are speculative, and similar forecasts have missed their mark before.
stories.whyItMatters: AI timelines move sentiment in AI-linked tokens and in miners pivoting to AI compute, even when the forecast is unproven.
whatToWatch: Whether the group publishes its full methodology
Reaction from other AI researchers to the claim
questions: Who produced this report, and what evidence backs it?
Why does the report pick a six-month window?

sources.title: AI watchdog report indicates we may have less than 6 months before AI super intelligence arrives

stories.title: Bank of England raises rates to 4%, sees inflation near 5% next year
stories.summary: The Bank of England raised its policy rate to 4%, CryptoSlate reported. The bank forecasts inflation near 5% next year. The move signals continued pressure on borrowing costs across the UK economy.
stories.whyItMatters: Higher rates and inflation forecasts shape risk appetite for Bitcoin and other assets traders treat as inflation hedges or risk-on bets.
whatToWatch: The Bank of England's next rate decision
Whether inflation tracks toward the 5% forecast
questions: How will UK markets price in further rate moves?
Will crypto markets react to the inflation forecast?

sources.title: Bank of England raises rates to 4% as it forecasts inflation near 5% next year

stories.title: NYSE-backed tokenization venture hits 90% stock rejection rate amid liquidity problems
stories.summary: A crypto venture backed by NYSE faces a 90% rejection rate on stock submissions, CryptoSlate reported. The report ties the problem to a $92 liquidity issue that threatens the venture's tokenization goals. The report does not name the venture or detail what the $92 figure refers to.
stories.whyItMatters: Stock tokenization is a closely watched bridge between traditional markets and crypto. Early stumbles test investor confidence in the model.
whatToWatch: Whether the venture addresses the liquidity shortfall
Any response from NYSE on the rejection rate
questions: What causes the 90% rejection rate?
What does the $92 figure refer to?

sources.title: NYSE-backed crypto venture faces 90% stock rejection as $92 liquidity problem threatens tokenization dream

stories.title: Binance cuts off SignalPlus after hackers breached it with a fake Teams invite
stories.summary: Binance cut ties with trading platform SignalPlus after hackers broke in using a fake Microsoft Teams meeting invite, CryptoSlate reported. The report does not detail the scale of the breach. It also does not state whether user funds were affected.
stories.whyItMatters: Social-engineering attacks are a leading cause of crypto security breaches. An exchange's response shows how it manages third-party risk.
whatToWatch: Whether SignalPlus discloses the scope of the breach
Any Binance statement on affected users or funds
questions: Were any user funds or data exposed?
How did the fake Teams invite get past SignalPlus's defenses?

sources.title: Binance cuts off trading platform SignalPlus after hackers break in with a fake Teams invite

stories.title: Researchers say cheap online services routed traffic through a White House-linked network
stories.summary: Researchers found that a set of low-cost online services routed web traffic through a network linked to the White House, CryptoSlate reported. The report gives few specifics on the services involved or how the link was established. It is not clear what role, if any, crypto plays in this network.
stories.whyItMatters: Proxy and VPN infrastructure has intersected with crypto scams and sanctions evasion before, so this link is worth watching even though it is unconfirmed.
whatToWatch: Further detail from researchers on the affected services
Any official response about the White House-linked network
questions: What specific services were involved?
What evidence ties the network to the White House?

sources.title: Cheap online services routed web traffic through a White House-linked network, researchers say
